acceptance: PASS only if plan-file evidence predates the first implementation mutation and matches the assigned task; absent, postdated, or chat-only plans fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis executor MUST persist its execution plan in the assigned file before beginning implementation.

acceptance: PASS only if every finding resolves to a pre-existing committed state/evidence coordinate and a report emitted before that coordinate exists fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis executor MUST state findings only after the state or evidence on which they rely has been committed to its authorized store.

acceptance: PASS only if a waiting turn records one active event subscription/wake and returns control, while no-wake, blocking-loop, and repeated-short-poll fixtures fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis turn MUST NOT end in a waiting state unless an event-driven wake is armed; homemade blocking polling and repeated short polling used as a wake mechanism are forbidden.

acceptance: PASS only if the third attempt follows a recorded diagnosis and materially changed mechanism/input; a third same-approach attempt fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: After two consecutive failures of one approach in private Praxis, the executor MUST diagnose the failure class and change mechanism before another attempt.

acceptance: PASS only if a repeated-symptom fixture identifies and changes the producer and a downstream-only repeated patch fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: When the same symptom recurs in private Praxis, remediation MUST target the producing mechanism rather than repeatedly patching downstream manifestations.

acceptance: PASS only if retry evidence names and proves a relevant changed input/mechanism; an unchanged command over unchanged state fails before execution. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A failed or hung private Praxis command MUST NOT be rerun unless at least one relevant input, fixture, configuration, code path, or execution mechanism has changed.

acceptance: PASS only if the pre-search inventory equals the updated caller set, post-search finds zero stale forms, and all owning checks pass; a planted stale caller fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Before a private Praxis callable signature changes, every call site MUST be enumerated, every affected caller MUST be updated in the same change, and a post-change search plus owning checks MUST prove no stale caller remains.

acceptance: PASS only if each sampled commit has one bounded purpose and a passing pre-commit owning-check receipt bound to its tree; mixed-purpose or unverified commits fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Each private Praxis commit MUST represent one coherent working step and MUST pass its owning verification before the commit is accepted.

acceptance: PASS only if a staged-red fixture is blocked, the same tree commits after the test is green, and hook bypass/disable fixtures fail policy validation. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis commit containing a staged failing test MUST be mechanically rejected by the commit hook; bypassing or disabling that gate is forbidden.

acceptance: PASS only if pre-count, replacement count, and post-count agree for the unique anchor and fixtures with a short ambiguous anchor, missed target, or doubled replacement fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis global replacement MUST use the longest pre-grepped unique anchor that identifies the intended occurrences and MUST run a post-search proving neither missed targets nor double application; short-substring replacement is forbidden.

acceptance: PASS only if before/after identity proves no change and blocks an identical retry; a retry proceeds only after a recorded relevant change. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis operation reporting no state change MUST be classified as a no-op and MUST NOT be retried with identical inputs and mechanism.

acceptance: PASS only if a change-to-check ownership matrix proves every affected owner ran and no required owner was inferred from an unrelated suite; both under-scoped and unjustifiably indiscriminate fixtures fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Private Praxis verification MUST use the smallest owning check set that fully covers the measured blast radius; unrelated full-suite execution MUST NOT substitute for an omitted owning check.

acceptance: PASS only if expectation precedes execution, a matching fixture proceeds, and a mismatching fixture stops before the next mutation with the mismatch recorded. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Before a risky private Praxis command executes, the executor MUST record its expected result and stop without further mutation when the observed result differs.

acceptance: PASS only if a fixture with at least three independent known reads records one batch/delegation and a serial waterfall fails; dependent or newly discovered reads are exempt. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Three or more independent private Praxis discovery reads available at one decision point MUST be issued as one batch or delegated together rather than serially requested.

acceptance: PASS only if the normal and fallback fixtures traverse the sanctioned primitive, raw osascript is absent, each verification is recorded, and transport/screen success without matching receiver acknowledgement never claims delivery. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Private Praxis conductor pane delivery MUST use the sanctioned send→verify→bounded Enter-fallback→re-verify sequence, MUST NOT call raw `osascript`, and MUST require receiver-side acknowledgement before claiming delivery.

acceptance: PASS only if terminal topology resolves both exact pane IDs to one window ID and a fixture placing them in different windows refuses before the pair run. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis teacher/student pair MUST be created as two split panes within one physical terminal window and MUST NOT create separate windows.

acceptance: PASS only if installation evidence is rooted in the new stand and predates pairing, while missing install, failed install, or package mutation in another stand refuses. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A newly cloned private Praxis student stand MUST run and pass its own declared installation before pairing and MUST NOT satisfy installation by mutating or borrowing another stand.

acceptance: PASS only if a fresh sandbox blocks a planted staged-red commit before first kick and then permits the corrected green commit; absent, unproven, disabled, or post-kick hooks fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Before its first task kick, every private Praxis student sandbox MUST contain an enabled pre-commit hook that has mechanically demonstrated rejection of a staged red test.

acceptance: PASS only if every standing lesson is proven unconditional across the frozen run classes and each conditional/goal-shaped fixture is rejected from curriculum and resolves to task acceptance. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Private Praxis standing curriculum MUST contain only obligations triggered on every run; goal-specific or conditional gaps MUST be expressed in the owning task's acceptance criteria instead.

acceptance: PASS only if the executed obligation set equals the parsed PORTION.md set exactly and fixtures with an extra, omitted, or overridden requirement fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: PORTION.md` MUST be the sole normative requirements source for a private Praxis student run; other messages or files may provide evidence but MUST NOT add, remove, or override obligations.

acceptance: PASS only if read telemetry shows only cited ranges before the first diagnosis and an uncited initial whole-module read fails; justified later expansion is recorded and allowed. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis student's initial code read MUST be limited to the exact edit-surface line ranges cited by `PORTION.md`; broader module reads require a later evidence-backed need.

acceptance: PASS only if command normalization equals the declared pytest target set and fixtures with an omitted target, added target, alternate suite, or zero collected tests fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis student MUST run exactly the pytest scope declared by `PORTION.md` and MUST NOT broaden, narrow, or substitute that scope.

acceptance: PASS only if failure is followed by a relevant fix and a hook-mediated passing retry, while bypass flags, disabled hooks, unchanged retries, and unverified commits fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: When the private Praxis commit hook reports pytest failure, the student MUST fix the failing test or implementation and retry through the enabled hook; hook bypass, disablement, or commit-without-recheck is forbidden.

acceptance: PASS only if silence within the tuple's measured bound causes no restart and eventual output is retained; silence beyond the bound follows the separately qualified timeout policy. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: For a private Praxis provider tuple whose qualification records cold-prefill behavior, first-token silence within the measured prefill bound MUST be classified as prefill and MUST NOT trigger restart.

acceptance: PASS only if message provenance shows teacher→student direct traffic and all non-teacher traffic traversing the conductor; any direct third-role message fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Only the assigned private Praxis teacher MAY communicate directly with its student; every other role MUST route communication through the conductor.

acceptance: PASS only if template conformance passes, every range resolves and matches grep evidence, and the construction example resolves to a passing test; missing or invented elements fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis teacher MUST create each portion from the governed template, using grep-verified real edit ranges and at least one type-construction example copied from an existing passing test.

acceptance: PASS only if supervision telemetry records one wait call with timeout equal to the measured remaining budget and zero re-arms/poll loops; any additional wait call fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Private Praxis teacher supervision MUST arm exactly one `wait-event.sh` call sized to the remaining run budget and MUST NOT use short re-arms or a homemade polling loop.

acceptance: PASS only if one audit receipt contains all four successful stages in that order and is bound to the commit; missing, reordered, stale, or failed stages block acceptance. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: On a private Praxis student commit, the teacher MUST verify in order: baseline parent identity, declared scoped tests, substantive test assertions, then independent mechanical revert-red.

acceptance: PASS only if an OPEN fixture blocks completion and retains an armed event wait, while completion becomes eligible only after exact conductor closure evidence. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis teacher MUST NOT declare completion while the run's OPEN marker exists and MUST remain under the governed event wait until conductor closure removes or closes that marker.

acceptance: PASS only if call-site and runtime inventories show the override on every pane/osascript Bash invocation and a planted missing-override call refuses before execution. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Every private Praxis Bash invocation that can touch panes or invoke `osascript` MUST enable the governed sandbox override explicitly.

acceptance: PASS only if the verifier receipt cites and evaluates primary sources independently and a fixture containing only a prior recommendation remains unverified. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis verifier MUST independently derive PASS or FAIL from primary artifacts and commands and MUST NOT adopt an acceptance recommendation as evidence.

acceptance: PASS only if positive-cardinality evidence passes and zero-collected, missing-count, filtered-empty, and unavailable-probe fixtures fail. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: For every green result, a private Praxis verifier MUST test whether the measured/collected set could be zero and MUST reject zero, missing, or unreported cardinality as false green.

acceptance: PASS only if verifier-owned green→revert-red→restore-green evidence is bound to its snapshot and a producer-only receipt fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis verifier MUST independently execute the mechanical revert-red control rather than rely on the producer's revert-red receipt.

acceptance: PASS only if an information-flow scan and adversarial fixture find zero answer-bearing material reachable by the student; one planted oracle leak fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis verification corpus MUST NOT expose the solution, expected patch, oracle output, or equivalent answer-bearing material to the student arm.

acceptance: PASS only if the corpus resolves a consumer/outcome assertion independent of the producer and a producer-only fixture fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis verification corpus MUST include at least one independent consumer/outcome check and MUST NOT validate only the producer or generation path.

acceptance: PASS only if the no-op control produces exactly zero and a planted corpus awarding any positive score to it fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A private Praxis verification corpus MUST score an unchanged/no-op submission as zero.

acceptance: PASS only if same-named roles in two entities resolve solely by complete pair, all bare/missing/guessed/alias/wrong-entity fixtures refuse, and public-marker scan is clean; otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Private Praxis role resolution across entity namespaces MUST use the exact `(entity, role)` pair. Bare role, missing entity, guessed current entity, first match and fallback alias MUST refuse. This control MUST NOT enter public TaskSeal schemas, fixtures, role values or documentation.

acceptance: PASS only if a pre-repair snapshot records exact artifact/state digests, an independent restore rehearsal returns byte/state-identically to that coordinate before repair begins, and the repair receipt binds the proof; mutation before proof, untested restore, wrong digest/state, guessed/latest target or reconstruction fails. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Before mutating a discovered live defect, private Praxis/HM repair MUST preserve and verify a rollback path to the exact pre-repair digest and state. If exact rollback cannot be proven before mutation, repair MUST refuse; a guessed, latest, reconstructed or post-mutation rollback point is invalid.

acceptance: PASS only if one documented command builds the static artifact locally with network disabled; accessibility and link checks pass; source/dependency/config scans find zero backend, auth, database, analytics, telemetry, or paid-host dependencies; and the artifact can be served locally without performing a deployment. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: The v0.1 landing and documentation site MUST build to static files and MUST require no application backend, authentication, database, analytics, telemetry, or paid hosting. The source MUST support local build and test without deployment, and the generated site MUST satisfy the project accessibility and broken-link gates. The specific static generator and zero-cost host remain P08/P15 parameters; deployment remains separately owner-gated.

acceptance: PASS only if a fixture containing dirty, untracked, and stashed state plus an occupied Reception worktree causes main/reused-worktree execution to refuse, a separate worktree to be selected, and before/after status and stash digests to remain identical for all unowned state. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Every mutating TaskSeal execution MUST use an explicitly identified dedicated non-`main` branch and isolated worktree. A private Stage B execution MUST use its own branch/worktree and MUST NOT reuse or disturb an active Reception worktree. Before mutation and after continuation or handoff, execution MUST record physical path, repository root, branch, HEAD, dirty/untracked state, and stash inventory; it MUST NOT clean, reset, delete, overwrite, or otherwise normalize state whose ownership is not proven.

acceptance: PASS only if a decision-fixture suite shows all evidence-resolvable reversible cases continue and every listed authority/safety-boundary case refuses pending an exact authorization. Any unnecessary routine pause or unauthorized boundary crossing is FAIL.
requirement: An executor MUST resolve routine implementation questions from repository and approved authority evidence and continue without asking the owner when the next action is reversible, in scope, and has no external side effect. It MUST pause when authority is absent or the action crosses a destructive, irreversible, publication, integration, activation, spending, external-contact, privacy, or safety boundary.

acceptance: PASS only if every shipped helper is assigned one allowlisted capability, static review finds no forbidden operation, and sandbox tests with instrumented Git/filesystem/network/purchase endpoints observe zero forbidden calls or mutations. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Execution-pack helpers MUST be local tools limited to verification, read-only Git inventory, privacy scanning, and compact deny-by-default allowlisted dossier packaging. They MUST NOT publish, push, delete, reset, purchase, mutate repository state, or call external APIs.

acceptance: PASS only if the ADR validator rejects every ADR missing any field, using a duplicate number, using a non-ISO date, or using a classification outside `public\|private`, and accepts the complete corpus. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Every canonical ADR MUST record a unique number, title, status, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` decision date, accountable owner, and `public` or `private` classification.

acceptance: PASS only if a changelog validator rejects an uncategorized pending entry, an unknown category, a release without an ISO date, and a release diff containing a labelled notable change absent from the changelog; the canonical changelog must pass. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: TaskSeal MUST maintain a changelog containing every notable user-visible `Added`, `Changed`, `Fixed`, `Security`, `Deprecated`, or `Removed` change. Released sections MUST use ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` dates; pending entries MUST live under `Unreleased` and one of those six categories.

acceptance: PASS only if the released repository exposes a working public issue URL, accepts a non-security test issue through the documented route, and the issue template redirects security reports to the private contact path. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: At public source alpha or later, the TaskSeal repository MUST expose a publicly readable issue tracker for defects, feature requests, and usage feedback, while security reports are redirected to the private security-contact path required by release governance.

acceptance: PASS only if `REL-12` and `REL-22` are PASS and an end-to-end CTA test reaches the configured monitored route without authentication or private-data exposure. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: A launch that presents the bounded paid setup MUST include at least one owner-approved, monitored contact CTA that works without user authentication and does not expose private owner data. Artifact installability remains governed by `REL-12`, and the reproducible demo remains governed by `REL-22`.

acceptance: PASS only if resolved realpaths prove the TaskSeal root is outside the Wisdom root, `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` is empty, Wisdom has no gitlink for TaskSeal, and extraction provenance shows no subtree history. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: The public TaskSeal repository MUST be physically outside the Wisdom repository tree and MUST be an independent sibling repository, not a nested repository, Git submodule, Git subtree, or gitlink-owned path of Wisdom.

acceptance: PASS only if the fleet registry has 3–5 unique active members, every member passes `LAB-18`, and every member has a dated source URL and recorded metric meeting one popularity threshold at admission. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: The standing exp-lab fleet MUST contain no fewer than three and no more than five active OSS projects, and every member MUST pass the separate license-eligibility control `LAB-18`. At admission, every member MUST also have a dated primary-source popularity signal of at least 10,000 GitHub stars or 1,000,000 package-registry downloads in the preceding 30 days.

acceptance: PASS only if every active fleet member has all four recorded fields and an approved compatibility result, required notices appear in the recording package, and a deliberately unresolved fixture is rejected. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Before a project enters the standing experiment fleet, its license review MUST record SPDX identifier, authoritative license URL, required attribution/notice handling, and an approved compatibility conclusion covering clone/build/test use and display of relevant code, UI, and logs in a published recorded video. Unresolved or incompatible projects MUST be excluded.

acceptance: PASS only if an intake validator finds one research record, exactly five option rows with all required fields, namespace separation from TaskSeal L0–L3, and an owner selection receipt before activation; absence of any item refuses activation. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Intake of every new exp-lab entity MUST perform a shallow evidence-backed research pass and present five mutually exclusive options—`L0`, `L1`, `L2`, `L3`, and `L4+`—with outcome, evidence needed, cost, risk, and rollback for each. These are exp-lab maturity levels, not TaskSeal context layers. No level may be activated before an exact owner selection is recorded.

acceptance: PASS only if the P02/P08 public-content inventory classifies every text-bearing artifact as English prose or a language-neutral identifier, independent review finds zero unresolved non-English normative text, and no locale changes a canonical ID or schema vector. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Canonical v0.1 public module prose, provenance descriptions, lessons, errors, documentation, and examples MUST be English. Stable machine IDs and schema keys remain language-neutral. Localization is deferred until a separately approved demand signal and MUST NOT change canonical IDs or contract semantics.

acceptance: PASS only if a tracked-target fixture retains its original digest and metadata, the `refuse` policy exits nonzero before provider birth, the runtime-placement policy writes only to the declared non-owned location and records its digest, and backup/merge/overwrite strategies are rejected. Otherwise FAIL.
requirement: Before real-repository use, every adapter MUST declare and evidence exactly one tracked-target collision policy: `refuse` before provider birth or place bytes in a qualified non-repository-owned runtime location. Silent overwrite, backup-and-overwrite, and merge into a repository-owned tracked target are forbidden. The adapter MUST record target ownership and the exact placed-byte digest.
